name: Campingplatz Litzelau
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Litzelau is located on the banks of the beautiful Inn in the Tiroler Oberland. The site offers direct access to the river and is surrounded by mountain hiking trails. Guests can choose between pitches for motorhomes and tent meadows. The sanitary facilities are well maintained, and a small playground for children is available. A kiosk on site sells staple foods and drinks.
